topPRs.author: NubsCarson
topPRs.body:
## Summary

- add reproducible Linux bootstrap, native Electrobun packaging, Flatpak confinement checks, and a fail-closed GLIBC portability audit
- add secure remote runtime enrollment, encrypted command relay, SSH fingerprint pinning, OS credential storage, and durable recovery
- add the canonical My Runtimes UI and Linux desktop parity surfaces

## Review repairs

The source was replayed onto current develop and repaired before publication:

- runtime credentials are bound to the exact selected runtime; renderer token-read RPC is removed
- SSH host-key scanning uses a fixed executable path, bounded stdout, and explicitly diagnostic stderr tails
- redirects and CR/LF/NUL header injection are rejected
- remote runner degradation is limited to typed transport failures; crypto, state, and programming faults rethrow
- cleanup failures preserve the primary failure, and queue-tail suppression points name their observation boundary
- loading, signed-out, error, empty, and pairing-status-unavailable states are distinct and visible
- My Runtimes remains the canonical hidden/developer-gated settings surface
- stale STATUS/report artifacts and unrelated documentation changes were removed
- the generated cloud router was rebuilt from the final route inventory rather than hand-edited

## Exact-head verification

Final reviewed head: `5da01c3bf5d8846f171e3e044ea9572a6824e4de`, squashed onto `develop@799d9b3467e2923b7a1ed16a84ea9e2417dad137`.

- 12 focused UI/native/runtime files: 75 tests passed
- real PGlite secure-relay migration: 1 test passed
- cloud/shared typecheck: passed
- generated router: 698 routes, 126 shards, 0 unconverted
- focused Biome and `git diff --check`: passed
- the earlier full UI typecheck passed before the last base refresh; on the final base, the only aggregate UI typecheck blocker is the newly merged `@extrastu/nuphy-ui` package missing from this shared installation, outside this PRs changed paths. Hosted CI installs the current lockfile and remains the authoritative aggregate gate.

## Explicit acceptance holds

These holds do not make the source draft-only, but they remain required before making a general Linux release claim:

- build native/fused inference artifacts in a trusted GLIBC <= 2.38 sysroot and pass the fail-closed packaged ELF audit; host-built GLIBC 2.43 artifacts are not releasable
- install and inspect the exact-head Flatpak on physical GNOME/Wayland hardware
- exercise real microphone, speaker, camera, and configured provider paths
- exercise SSH pairing and reconnect against an independent Linux device or VPS and the real OS credential store

Until those gates are recorded, this is mergeable source for Linux/remote-runtime support, not proof of a generally available Linux release.

Part 6 (final orchestrator part) of the split series closing out #24262.

cc @lalalune

## Content-budget closure response (supersedes #24423)

- **Bulk issue creation**: processes every item (the first-25 slice is gone); per-item results report each outcome.
- **Issue lists/bodies**: listings echo `{limit, total, hasMore}` explicit pagination; bodies project durably with references instead of silent 4KB clips.
- **Request text truncated before inference**: gone — spawn-ack and issue-body inference inputs are complete.
- **Workspace/task text slices**: gone (workspace paths, history/session listings echo their pagination contract).

## Scope — the TASKS action surface + satellites

- **Cancel that cancels**: `runCancel` interrupts the durable task before session teardown (single, all, and room-fallback paths); an unmatched `search` is a miss, not a room-wide stop; room-wide interrupts are owner-scoped.
- **Send vs create routing on the user's words**: a send into a finished lane is classified follow-up / related / fresh from the user's own text (planner paraphrases dropped the anaphors); a new deliverable never inherits the predecessor's title, acceptance criteria, or route workdir (a prime-script ask was graded against a .ts-count contract and parked, live); workdir routes match the genuine turn's words only.
- **Titles/labels/slugs**: uncapped canonical title/label storage (develop's `completeUserReferenceView`/`labelFrom`), planner-junk sanity guards, and served slugs that stop at the first clause boundary (`tip-calculator-page`, not `tip-calculator-page-with-input`).
- **Spawn honesty**: post-attach interrupt re-check before the first prompt (a cancel landing mid-spawn found no session to stop and the build ran anyway); per-origin spawn caps; admin-stop stamps land before stops so a kill never narrates as a task failure.
## Stack
